A1.justification: Both complete 21-page PDFs contain the same paper and Appendices A–E. Text and rendering comparisons establish identical substantive content; the only visible difference is the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original experiments comparing I-WALT and V-WALT across ten downstream tasks, with quantitative results in Tables 3–4 and ablations and qualitative analyses in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original downstream evaluations, ablations, generation-quality analyses and qualitative predictions, including the results in Tables 1–4.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.4 retain identical WALT variants, diffusion objectives, feature-extraction procedures and task-specific readout heads.

E1.justification: The same pretraining data and ten downstream task/dataset combinations remain. The DAVIS visualizations and manipulated-video motion scenarios are also unchanged (Sections 3–4 and Appendix D).

E2.justification: Tables 3–4 retain the same I-JEPA, ImageMAE, SigLIP, DINOv2, V-JEPA and VideoMAEv1 comparators and model variants, alongside the same WALT comparisons.

E3.justification: Frozen-backbone probing, evaluation metrics, model sizes, noise/block settings, data splits, frame sampling and training budgets are identical in Sections 3–4 and Appendices D–E.

E4.justification: The noise/block and training-progress ablations, generation-quality correlations, motion visualizations and qualitative prediction cases are unchanged, including Appendices A and C.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical, including the Pearson and Spearman correlation analyses in Tables 1–2. No run-count, seed, uncertainty or significance-reporting information is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted trends and qualitative predictions are unchanged. For example, Table 3 retains ImageNet accuracy of 0.607 for I-WALT 284M and 0.618 for V-WALT 284M in both versions.

T1.justification: The diffusion definitions and denoising objective in Section 3.1 and mathematical formulations in Section 3.4 are identical. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or altered.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and discussion retain the same matched-architecture comparison, claims about video-pretraining benefits and contributions concerning motion representations, training budget and model scale.

C2.justification: The motion-sensitivity interpretations, task-dependent training effects, semantic-task weaknesses and limitation to one model architecture remain unchanged (Sections 4–5 and appendices).

D1.justification: Implementation details, preprocessing, readout architectures and parameter counts, optimizer schedules and checkpoint-access disclosures are unchanged, including Appendices D–E and Tables 5–7.

R1.justification: Section 2 and all 69 references are identical. The comparisons with concurrent work and positioning of WALT as enabling a controlled image/video comparison are unchanged.

P1.justification: The first-page margin stamp changes from arXiv v1 dated 10 Feb 2025 to v2 dated 19 Mar 2025. The title, authors, prose, terminology and document structure are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–12 and Tables 1–7 retain identical graphics, captions, axes, legends, structure and placement. Page layout is unchanged; rendering differences are confined to the margin stamp text.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves the same scientific content, evidence, explanations, limitations and presentation throughout the main paper and Appendices A–E. Updating only the arXiv version/date stamp produces no meaningful improvement or deterioration in overall paper quality.
